option_label: Same shape, simpler numbers: +1 per wet tile, 0 otherwise; inputs and price as drafted
judgment: Why not reward a tile being watered, and give no reward at all for other actions? There's no actual penalty to a human for not watering, so it seems strange to penalize the bot. I am thinking in terms of Barto and Sutton's formulation of Reinforcement Learning (2nd ed). Inputs approved as drafted. 800 gold.
